title: Numerical evidence for conjectures on negative discrete second moments of Dirichlet L-functions: data and code
description: Data, code and pre-registration documents for a numerical test of Conjectures 7 and 8 of A. Pearce-Crump (arXiv:2606.25094) on the negative discrete second moments sum 1/|L'(rho,chi)|^2 and sum |L(2rho,chi^2)/L'(rho,chi)|^2 of Dirichlet L-functions. Zeros of L(s,chi) for the real primitive characters of conductor 4, 5, 8 and 12 (2000-3000 zeros each, verified complete), derivatives at the zeros, values of L(2rho,chi^2), values of |zeta'(rho)| and |zeta(2rho)| for the first 27000 zeros of zeta, and a script that reproduces all results of the accompanying note. In all eight tests the predicted arithmetic factor lies in the 95% interval and the value without arithmetic factor is excluded. Numerical evidence, not a proof. Prepared with substantial assistance from an AI system (Claude, Anthropic).
